children: , faces a tougher test than selling more AI chips: turning those sales into profit. Its Class A shares stood at $341.43 at 10.55am EST on October 16, down 1%. Investor's Business Daily reported Friday that Evercore ISI forecasts chip-system sales could supply 35% of Google Cloud revenue in 2027. That is a Wall Street estimate, not an Alphabet commitment.

Cloud already delivers substantial earnings. Alphabet's July 22 earnings release reported second-quarter Cloud operating income of $8.814 billion on revenue of $24.768 billion, implying a 35.6% operating margin. But that figure covers the whole segment. It does not establish how much profit Google earns from selling its Tensor Processing Unit systems. Investors cannot simply multiply a chip-sales forecast by Cloud's current margin and call the result future earnings.

The valuation leaves little room for loose assumptions. The GF Value chart places the $341.43 share price 33.73% above its $255.32 estimated value, suggesting investors already pay a premium for future growth. That estimate is no guaranteed price destination. The useful test is whether a bigger hardware business lifts Cloud operating profit alongside revenue and improves returns on infrastructure spending. Until Alphabet provides clearer chip economics, the 35% forecast describes a potential revenue mixnot a proven earnings payoff.

title: Alphabet Stocks Fall Although AI-Chip Forecast Signals a Bigger Cloud Business
